1.text: Zaburi ya Dawidi.Uwiteka uncire urubanza,Kuko gukiranuka kwanjye ari ko ngenderamo,Kandi niringira Uwiteka ntashidikanya.

2.text: Uwiteka, unyitegereze ungerageze,Gerageza umutima wanjye n'ubwenge bwanjye,

3.text: Kuko imbabazi zawe nzireba mu maso yanjye,Kandi ngendera mu murava wawe.

5.text: Nanga iteraniro ry'inkozi z'ibibi,Kandi sinzicarana n'abanyabyaha.

6.text: Nzakaraba ntafite igicumuro,Ni ko nzazenguruka igicaniro cyawe Uwiteka,

7.text: Kugira ngo numvikanishe ijwi ry'ishimwe,Mvuge imirimo yose itangaza wakoze.

8.text: Uwiteka, nkunda ubuturo ari bwo nzu yawe,N'ahantu ubwiza bwawe buba.

9.text: Ntukureho umwuka wanjye ubwo uzakuraho abanyabyaha,Cyangwa ubugingo bwanjye nk'abavusha amaraso.

10.text: Amaboko yabo arimo igomwa,Ukuboko kwabo kw'iburyo kuzuye impongano.

11.text: Ariko jyeweho gukiranuka kwanjye ni ko nzagenderamo,Uncungure, umbabarire.

12.text: Ikirenge cyanjye gihagaze aharinganiye,Mu materaniro nzashimiramo Uwiteka.
